items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Fletcher Henderson in the context of listening to records and hearing bands ('I used to listen to every instrument... Fletcher Henderson at the piano'), but does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct professional relationship.

ctx.x: I liked the Mamie Smith records. Mamie Smith and the Jazz Hounds. And...oh, there was quite a... Fletcher Henderson at the piano and... I used to listen to every instrument, you know. I was very interested in the way they sounded.
